detail.title: CP-UNR-4K516R8-FI
features: Up to 16 Channels IP camera input
Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264, MJPEG codec decoding
AI by Recorder: 2 Channel face detection and recognition, Scalable to 50,000 faces, 4 Channels perimeter protection, 8 Channels IMD+
AI by Camera: Face detection and recognition, Perimeter protection, IMD+, Metadata,  ANPR, Stereo analysis, Heat map, People counting
Support 8 SATA HDDs up to 20TB Each, 4 USB Ports (2 front USB 2.0 ports, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports)

General.Video Output: 2 VGA:1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720        2 HDMI:3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720   Heterogeneous video source output for HDMI1 and HDMI2     Simultaneous video source output for VGA1 and HDMI1       Simultaneous video source output for VGA2 and HDMI2
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 2 Channel 32MP@20 fps, 2 Channel 24MP@20 fps, 4 Channel 16MP@30 fps, 5  Channel 12MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 12 Channel 5MP@30 fps, 16 Channel  4MP@30 fps  AI enabled: 1 Channel 32MP@20 fps, 1 Channel 24MP@20 fps, 2 Channel 16MP@30 fps, 4  Channel 12MP@30 fps, 4 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 5MP@30 fps, 12 Channel  4MP@30 fps
General.AI by NVR: Face detection, Face recognition, Perimeter protection, IMD+
General.AI by Camera: Face detection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor vehicles, Non-motor vehi cles), Perimeter protection, IMD+, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People counting, ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map
General.IntelliCheck AI by Camera + Recorder: Max. 16 Channel, 1 combined event per Channel/s
General.Network Bandwidth: AI disabled: 384 Mbps incoming, 384 Mbps recording and 384 Mbps outgoing   AI enabled: 200 Mbps incoming, 200 Mbps recording and 200 Mbps outgoing
General.Perimeter Performance AI by NVR (Number: 4 channels, 10 IVS rules for each Channel
General.Face Attributes: Gender, Age group, Glasses, Expressions, Face mask, Beard
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 Channels (up to 12 face images/s each Channel)
General.Face Database Capacity: Scalable to 50,000 faces, with a total storage capacity of 2.5 GB. Each face image can store additional information, including Name, Gender, Birthday, Address, Credential Type, Credential Number, Country/Region, and State
General.Face Recognition Performance of AI by NV: 1.16 Channel FD (by camera) + FR (by NVR), image stream: 16 face images/s 2.2 Channel FD (by recorder) + FR (by NVR), video stream: 12 face images/s
General.IMD+ by NVR: 8 Channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.Human Attributes: Top color, Top type, Bottom color, Bottom type, Hat, Bag, Age, Gender and Umbrella
General.Motor Vehicle Attributes: License plate, Plate color, Vehicle body, Vehicle model, Vehicle logo, Calling, Seatbelt, Vehicle  Interior, Vehicle registration location
General.Non-motor Vehicle Attributes: Vehicle model, Vehicle color, Number of persons, Helmet
General.License Plate Database Capacity: 1. Create up to 20,000 plate numbers                                      2. Blocklist and allowlist
General.Abnormality Alarm: Camera offline, Storage error, Disk full, IP conflict, MAC conflict, Login lock, Abnormal  behaviour of fan, Cyber security exception
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection, Perimeter protection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor vehi cles, Non-motor vehicles), SMD Plus, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People counting,  ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map
General.General Alarm: Motion detection; privacy masking; local alarm
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), Local alarm output, IPC external alarm output, Access control ler, Audio, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email
General.Hard Disk: 8 SATA ports, each disk can contain up to 20 TB. This limit varies depending on the environ ment temperature
General.Record Mode: General, Motion detection, Intelligent, Alarm, POS
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback (face and  motion detection)
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, DDNS, Alarm Server, Multicast,  P2P, Auto Registration, iSCSI, ONVIF 23.12(Profile T, Profile S, Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Interface Ports: 4 (2 front USB 2.0 ports, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports), 1 eSATA Port, 1 RS232, 2 RS485 (1 port for half duplex serial communication, 1 port for full-duplex serial communication)
General.Network Mode: Multi-address mode, load balance, fault tolerance and other network port binding modes
General.Power Consumption: Total output of NVR is ≤ 13 W (without HDD)
